description: Enable multiple Ralph instances to run simultaneously in the same or different repositories with proper isolation, automatic work distribution via story locking, feature branch git strategy, and TUI dashboard monitoring.

userStories.title: Instance Identification System
acceptanceCriteria: Generate unique instance ID at startup: {user}-{hostname}-{pid}-{timestamp}
Instance ID is logged in all output with [INSTANCE_ID] prefix
Instance ID is stored in instance-specific directory
Short ID (first 8 chars) available for convenience commands
Tests: run ralph.sh and verify unique ID generation
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: ralph.sh generates INSTANCE_ID={user}-{hostname}-{pid}-{timestamp}, logs with [SHORT_ID] prefix, stores in instances/{id}/ directory.

userStories.title: Instance Workspace Isolation
acceptanceCriteria: Create instances/{instance-id}/ directory on startup
Instance-specific files: ralph.log, progress.txt, status.json in instance dir
Shared prd.json remains in ralph root directory
Old instance directories cleaned up after 7 days by default
ralph-cleanup.sh script created for manual purge
Tests: launch instance and verify directory structure created
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: init_instance() creates instances/{id}/ with ralph.log, progress.txt, status.json. ralph-cleanup.sh handles purging with --old and --dead flags.

userStories.title: Story Locking Mechanism
acceptanceCriteria: locks/ directory created for story locks
Atomic lock acquisition using mkdir (POSIX atomic)
Lock directory contains: owner file with instance ID, timestamp file
Lock released on story completion or instance exit
Stale lock detection: locks older than 2 hours can be force-released
ralph-locks.sh script with status and release commands
Tests: verify lock prevents second claim, verify stale detection
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: acquire_story_lock() uses mkdir atomic, stores owner/timestamp/pid. cleanup_stale_lock() handles 2hr timeout and dead instance detection. ralph-locks.sh provides status/release/cleanup commands.

userStories.title: Automatic Story Claiming
acceptanceCriteria: On iteration start, scan PRD for unclaimed incomplete stories
Skip stories locked by other instances
Claim by priority order (lowest priority number first)
If no stories available, wait 30s and retry (max 5 retries then exit)
Log which story was claimed: [INSTANCE_ID] Claimed US-XXX
PRD updated with claimedBy field showing instance ID
Tests: run two instances, verify they claim different stories
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: claim_next_story() scans PRD with jq, sorts by priority, skips locked stories, claims first available with lock+PRD update. 5 retries with 30s wait.

userStories.title: PRD Atomic Updates
acceptanceCriteria: Use flock for exclusive lock during PRD read-modify-write
Lock timeout of 5 seconds with retry logic
JSON integrity validated after write using jq
Backup to prd.json.bak before each modification
All PRD changes logged with instance ID and change type
Tests: concurrent jq updates don't corrupt file
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: read_prd() uses flock -s shared lock, update_prd() uses flock -w 5 exclusive lock with 3 retries. Creates prd.json.bak backup, validates JSON with jq empty.

userStories.title: Feature Branch Isolation
acceptanceCriteria: Create branch ralph/{instance-short-id}/{story-id} when claiming story
All commits go to instance-specific branch
On story completion, merge to main ralph branch with --no-ff
Rebase instance branch before merge if behind
Clean up merged branches automatically
Tests: verify branch created, commits isolated, merge works
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: create_story_branch() creates ralph/{short-id}/{story-id} branch. merge_story_branch() merges with --no-ff, handles conflicts with abort, deletes merged branch.

userStories.title: Instance Status Tracking
acceptanceCriteria: instances/{id}/status.json updated every 30 seconds
Status contains: instanceId, currentStory, iteration, startTime, lastHeartbeat
Status contains: storiesCompleted count, storiesFailed count, state enum
State values: starting, idle, claiming, working, merging, terminated
Atomic writes via temp file + mv
Tests: verify status.json valid JSON and updates
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: update_status() writes to status.json.tmp then mv for atomic update. Contains all required fields. States: starting, idle, claiming, working, merging, terminated, completed, max_iterations.

userStories.title: TUI Dashboard - Basic Display
acceptanceCriteria: ralph-dashboard.sh script created
Displays table: Instance ID | Story | Status | Iteration | Runtime
Auto-refresh every 2 seconds using watch or loop
Color coding: green=working, yellow=idle, red=error, gray=dead
Overall PRD progress shown: X/Y stories complete
Exit with q key or Ctrl+C
Tests: launch dashboard, verify it shows running instances
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: ralph-dashboard.sh with TUI using tput colors. Shows instance table, PRD progress bar, auto-refresh 2s, color coding by state. Keys: q=quit, r=refresh, l=locks, c=cleanup.

userStories.title: TUI Dashboard - Instance Details
acceptanceCriteria: Arrow keys navigate between instances in dashboard
Enter key shows detailed view for selected instance
Detail view: last 20 log lines, current story acceptance criteria, branch
l key opens full log with less or tail -f
b key shows git log for instance branch
ESC or q returns to main dashboard view
Tests: verify navigation and detail view work
userStories.notes: Partial: Dashboard has l key for locks view. Full navigation/detail view requires dialog or more complex TUI - deferred.

userStories.title: Multi-Repo Support
acceptanceCriteria: Global state directory: ~/.ralph/global/
Repo namespace: hash of absolute repo path (first 8 chars of md5)
Each repo has isolated locks and instances under global dir
ralph-dashboard.sh --all shows instances from all repos
ralph-dashboard.sh --repo PATH filters to specific repo
No collision between repos even with same story IDs
Tests: run ralph in two different repos, verify isolation
userStories.notes: Dashboard has --all and --repo flags but global directory not yet implemented. Each repo uses local instances/ and locks/ directories which provides repo isolation.

userStories.title: Graceful Shutdown
acceptanceCriteria: Trap SIGINT (Ctrl+C), SIGTERM, SIGHUP signals
On signal: release all held story locks
On signal: update status.json to state=terminated
On signal: git stash any uncommitted changes with message
On signal: log termination with cleanup summary
Tests: send SIGTERM to ralph, verify locks released
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: trap handlers for EXIT, INT, TERM, HUP. cleanup_on_exit() releases locks, updates status, stashes uncommitted changes, logs cleanup.

userStories.title: Dead Instance Detection
acceptanceCriteria: Instance considered dead if lastHeartbeat > 5 minutes ago
Dead instance locks automatically released by any live instance
Dead instance claimedBy fields cleared in PRD
Warning logged when dead instance detected and cleaned
Dashboard shows dead instances with strikethrough or gray
Tests: kill -9 an instance, verify another cleans up locks
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: cleanup_stale_lock() checks heartbeat age >300s, releases lock and clears claimedBy. Dashboard shows dead instances in red. ralph-cleanup.sh --dead handles batch cleanup.

userStories.title: Parallel Launch Script
acceptanceCriteria: ralph-parallel.sh N launches N ralph instances
Each instance runs in background with nohup
PIDs tracked in instances/running.pids file
ralph-parallel.sh stop sends SIGTERM to all tracked PIDs
ralph-parallel.sh status shows count and PIDs of running instances
Default N = number of CPU cores / 2 (minimum 1)
Tests: ralph-parallel.sh 3 launches 3 instances
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: ralph-parallel.sh with launch N, stop, kill, status, dashboard commands. Uses nohup, tracks PIDs, CPU-aware defaults, RALPH_MAX_INSTANCES limit.

userStories.title: Merge Queue
acceptanceCriteria: Completed stories added to merge-queue.json with timestamp
Merge process runs one at a time (flock on merge operation)
Automatic rebase if instance branch behind main ralph branch
Failed merges logged and flagged in queue as needs_manual
Dashboard shows merge queue status
Option --no-auto-merge to create PR instead
Tests: complete two stories, verify sequential merge
userStories.notes: Ensures clean git history. Merge conflicts rare with feature branches but handled.

userStories.title: Configuration File
acceptanceCriteria: ralph.config.json in ralph directory (optional)
Env vars override config: RALPH_MAX_INSTANCES, RALPH_LOCK_TIMEOUT, etc
Settings: maxInstances (default 4), lockTimeout (default 7200s)
Settings: heartbeatInterval (default 30s), cleanupTTL (default 7d)
Settings: mergeStrategy (merge|pr), branchPattern (customizable)
Zero config required - sensible defaults work out of box
Tests: set config value, verify it takes effect
userStories.notes: Allow customization without code changes. Load config at startup.

userStories.title: Documentation
acceptanceCriteria: README.md updated with Multi-Instance section
docs/multi-instance.md created with detailed guide
Architecture diagram in docs (ASCII art or mermaid)
Troubleshooting section: stuck locks, dead instances, merge conflicts
Examples: parallel launch, dashboard commands, lock management
Tests: documentation renders correctly, no broken links
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: docs/multi-instance.md with full guide including architecture diagram, commands reference, troubleshooting, and configuration. README update pending.

qualityChecks.manual: Launch 2+ instances and verify no conflicts

references: POSIX file locking: flock(1), mkdir atomicity
